errors.empty: No transactions found in the file.
errors.noAccount: Add an account before importing a statement.
errors.tooBig: File too large. Export a shorter period (up to 5 MB).
errors.unreadable: Couldn't read the file. Try exporting the statement again.

howTo: In your bank's app or website, open the statement and look for “Export” or “Download”. OFX is the most reliable; CSV works too. Nothing is saved before you review it.
rulesHint: The categories you choose become rules: next time you import, similar transactions come in already categorized. Transfers between your own accounts: uncheck them and record them as a transfer.

csv.intro: I didn't recognize the columns in this CSV. Tell me which is which:
csv.invert: Expenses show as positive in the file (common in card statements)
